title: Data Preprocessing: Importance of Training-Test Split in ML Model Evaluation

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're talking about the importance of splitting your data set into a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 今天要談的是，為什麼必須把資料集切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Let's imagine that you are tasked to predict the sale prices of cars, and that is your dependent variable.
cues.zh: 假設你的任務是預測汽車售價，售價就是依變數。

cues.en: And your independent variables are the mileage of the car and its age.
cues.zh: 自變數則是汽車的里程數與車齡。

cues.en: And in your data that are supplied to you you have 20 cars in total.
cues.zh: 提供給你的資料中，總共有 20 輛車。

cues.en: Of course, that's not a lot, but for illustrative purposes for our tutorial, that will be sufficient.
cues.zh: 數量當然不多，但用來示範已經足夠。

cues.en: So what splitting your data implies is separating a part of your data out before you do anything.
cues.zh: 所謂切分資料，就是在開始任何工作之前，先分出一部分資料。

cues.en: And usually that's about 20% of the data.
cues.zh: 通常大約是資料的 20%。

cues.en: So since we have 20 cars here that's about four cars that we separate out.
cues.zh: 這裡有 20 輛車，因此大約會分出四輛。

cues.en: So what that means is that the bulk of our data 80% will be our training set and the separated 20% will be our test set.
cues.zh: 也就是主要的 80% 資料作為訓練集，另外分出的 20% 作為測試集。

cues.en: We'll use our training set to build the model.
cues.zh: 我們會使用訓練集建立模型。

cues.en: So in this case we're building a linear regression and then we will take the cars from the test set we will apply our model to them.
cues.zh: 這裡建立的是線性迴歸模型，再把模型套用到測試集中的汽車。

cues.en: So they haven't been part of the model creation process.
cues.zh: 這些車沒有參與模型建立的過程。

cues.en: The model has no information about these cars.
cues.zh: 模型完全沒有這些車的資訊。

cues.en: And now we're applying this model to them.
cues.zh: 現在，我們把模型套用到它們身上。

cues.en: And it's predicting certain values, certain prices.
cues.zh: 模型會預測出一些數值，也就是售價。

cues.en: But the good news is that because this is something we separated in advance as part of the data that was given to us we actually know the actual prices.
cues.zh: 好消息是，這些資料原本就是提供給我們的完整資料，只是事先分出來，所以我們知道實際售價。

cues.en: So now we can compare the predicted values which were generated using a model that has never seen these cars before, and we can compare that
cues.zh: 因此，可以把一個從未看過這些汽車的模型所產生的預測值，

cues.en: to the actual values that we know what these cars sold for.
cues.zh: 與我們已知的實際成交價格進行比較。

cues.en: And so from that we can evaluate our model.
cues.zh: 藉此就能評估模型。

cues.en: Is it doing a good job?
cues.zh: 模型表現好嗎？

cues.en: Is it doing a not so good job?
cues.zh: 還是不太好？

cues.en: And do we need to improve it?
cues.zh: 我們是否需要改善？

cues.en: And that's how we split a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 這就是訓練集與測試集的切分方式。

cues.en: And that's why it's important to do that.
cues.zh: 也是這個步驟為什麼重要。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you on the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下堂課見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
